question: US x Iran Effective Ceasefire by September 4?

# Research report 1 of 2

## Summary

As of September 9, the question is not settled. The latest US strike on Iranian land I could confirm is September 1. If nothing hits Iranian land from September 2 on, a 14-day pause would finish at about noon ET on September 15 or 16. A strike on Iranian land after September 4 would make this market (deadline September 4) resolve No. The biggest uncertainty is the US strikes on Iranian oil tankers on September 5 and 8. Most were clearly at sea, but two were close to Iranian islands or coast, and those could be argued to fall in Iranian "internal waters."

## 1. Resolution source
- The rules don't name a URL, only "a consensus of resolution sources" (major media and official statements). I couldn't open the Polymarket rules page and couldn't find out exactly when the market was created.
- 2026-09-02 (approx.): A Polymarket ladder, "When will the US and Iran achieve a two-week ceasefire?", uses the same 14-day rule. [lines.com](https://www.lines.com/prediction-markets/world/us-x-iran-effective-ceasfire-byptptpt-2-week-pause-20260715194822042)

## 2. Current status
- 2026-09-01: CENTCOM began strikes on Revolutionary Guard (IRGC) targets inside Iran at 12 p.m. ET. Targets included air defenses, radars, mine-laying capability and communications sites. Iranian media reported hits at Bandar Abbas, Jask, Chabahar, Minab, Sirik, Konarak and Qeshm. These clearly qualify. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/09/01/politics/us-military-strikes-iran), [Axios](https://www.axios.com/2026/09/01/hormuz-centcom-strikes-trump-iran), [IranWire](https://iranwire.com/en/news/157043-centcom-launches-strikes-on-irgc-positions-in-iran/)
- I found no confirmed US strike on Iranian land from September 2 to 9. I couldn't load the USNI piece of September 4 or the Wikipedia pages to double-check this.
- If September 1 was the last qualifying strike, the pause runs from September 2 to about noon ET on September 15. If strikes carried into early September 2 ET, it would run to September 16.
- The tanker strikes are the main judgment call:
  - 2026-09-05: US forces disabled the tanker M/T Downy "off the coast of Kharg Island" and M/T Stark 1 "near Jask", and destroyed M/T Kylo in the Gulf of Oman. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/09/05/middleeast/iran-us-tanker-kharg-intl), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/05/us-iran-oil-tankers-navy-missile-attack.html)
  - 2026-09-08: Five tankers were hit: four in the Gulf of Oman and M/T Derya "near Kharg Island". [The Hill](https://thehill.com/policy/defense/6077471-us-strikes-irgc-oil-tankers/), [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/09/08/politics/us-targets-iran-tankers)
  - Strikes at sea are excluded by the rules. The Kharg Island and Jask cases are the only ones a resolver might treat as internal waters, which would mean No.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-08/09: The US struck five tankers. Iran said it fired missiles at a US base in Jordan and attacked 10 ships. CENTCOM said "all IRGC attempted attacks failed." [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/9/us-destroys-five-iranian-tankers-iran-retaliates-with-attacks-on-jordan-base)
- 2026-09-06: Parliament speaker Ghalibaf threatened a "more painful" response, and the US naval blockade continued. [CBS](https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/iran-war-us-trump-diesel-gas-prices-labor-day/), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/6/iran-touts-military-response-as-us-maintains-blockade-hits-tankers)
- 2026-09-05: The tanker strikes came after the IRGC fired ballistic missiles at a US carrier and destroyer. [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/09/05/nx-s1-5959159/us-iran-warships-targeted)
- 2026-09-01/02: After the land strikes, Iran fired missiles at Jordan, Bahrain, Kuwait and Iraqi Kurdistan, and Trump warned of "much harder" strikes. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/2/iran-us-exchange-new-attacks-who-was-hit-in-latest-strikes)
- 2026-08-30: The US struck two rocket launchers on Larak Island, an Iranian island in the Strait of Hormuz. It was the first US strike on Iran since late July. Iran hit back at Jordan on August 31. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/30/politics/us-iran-strikes-larak-island), [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/middle-east/article/3365782/us-forces-strike-two-iranian-launchers-irans-larak-island-us-official-says)
- 2026-08-17: The 60-day US-Iran memorandum expired with no deal. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/8/17/us-iran-memorandum-of-understanding-expires-how-and-why-it-fell-apart)

## 4. Base rates
- 2026-08-18: GlobalSecurity said there had been no US strike inside Iran for 19 straight nights. The gap from late July to August 30 was about 29 days, so 14-day pauses have happened before. [GlobalSecurity](https://www.globalsecurity.org/military/ops/iran-war-20260818.htm)
- 2026-07-07 to 07-12: After the earlier ceasefire collapsed, the US struck on several days in a row (more than 300 targets over three nights). Escalation episodes have tended to be short bursts of a few days. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/13/missile-strikes-and-attacks-on-ships-reported-around-strait-of-hormuz)
- Since September 1, the US has answered Iranian missile attacks on its ships by hitting tankers at sea rather than targets on land.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I couldn't find current prices, Manifold or Kalshi equivalents, or expert forecasts.

- About September 15 or 16, noon ET: the 14-day pause would be complete if no qualifying strike happens.
- Escalation risk: Iran keeps firing missiles at US ships and at Jordan, and Trump has threatened bigger strikes. Any US strike on Iran's coast, islands or ports, such as Bandar Abbas, Qeshm, Larak or Kharg, would end the run.
- If tankers are hit again near Kharg or other Iranian ports, resolvers will have to decide whether those waters count as internal waters.
- Around September 9: Trump said talks with Iran are possible and the war would end after the November 3 midterms. [Al Jazeera liveblog](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/9/9/iran-war-live-us-hits-iranian-tankers-irgc-attacks-us-base-in-jordan)

# Research report 2 of 2 (written independently)

I finished the searches. Several direct page fetches (Polymarket, Wikipedia, CNN, Critical Threats, GlobalSecurity) were blocked by the proxy, so some details below come from search-result summaries and could not be checked against the full pages.

## 1. Resolution source
- The criteria give no URL. The market is Polymarket's "US x Iran Effective Ceasefire begins by...? (2 week pause)". It resolves on a "consensus of information" from its resolution sources. I could not load the page itself. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/us-x-iran-effective-ceasefire-begins-byptptpt-2-week-pause)
- I could not find when the September 4 contract was created. That date matters: if no qualifying strike happened after creation, the 14-day clock starts on the creation date.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The last US strike on Iranian land I could confirm was the wave on September 1, 2026.
- If that is the latest qualifying action, a clean 14-day period would start September 2 and finish at 12:00 PM ET on September 15. That is after today, so it is not complete.
- The big open question is whether the tanker strikes on September 5 and 8 count. The criteria exclude maritime territory and count only land and internal waters. Ships were hit "off" Kharg Island, "off" Jask, "near Kharg" and in the Gulf of Oman, which reads as at sea. If any of them were in Iranian internal waters or at a port berth, the clock would restart on that date. I found no source that pins down their legal location.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-08/09: The US says it destroyed five more Iranian crude tankers in the Gulf of Oman and near Kharg. Iran says it attacked 10 ships near Hormuz and a base in Jordan. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/9/us-destroys-five-iranian-tankers-iran-retaliates-with-attacks-on-jordan-base); [Fox](https://www.foxnews.com/live-news/iran-war-news-trump-israel-september-8)
- 2026-09-08: A GlobalSecurity daily update reportedly says no coalition strikes on Iran or Iranian vessels were recorded between its September 7 and 8 cutoffs. This is from a search snippet only. [GlobalSecurity](https://www.globalsecurity.org/military/ops/iran-war-20260908.htm)
- 2026-09-05: CENTCOM says it hit three tankers after the IRGC fired ballistic missiles at two US Navy warships: the Downy off Kharg, the Stark 1 off Jask, and the Kylo, destroyed in the Gulf of Oman. [WaPo](https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2026/09/05/us-says-it-hit-3-iranian-oil-tankers-including-one-near-kharg-island/); [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/09/05/middleeast/iran-us-tanker-kharg-intl); [USNI](https://news.usni.org/2026/09/04/u-s-iran-trade-strikes-in-strait-of-hormuz-as-both-battle-on-social-media)
- 2026-09-03/04: Iran fires drones and missiles at US bases in the UAE, Kuwait and Jordan. [Critical Threats](https://www.criticalthreats.org/analysis/iran-update-september-4-2026)
- 2026-09-03: Vice President Vance says he is "extremely skeptical" of reports that a US strike hit a wedding, and that he "wouldn't call it a war." [GV Wire](https://gvwire.com/2026/09/03/i-wouldnt-call-it-a-war-vance-plays-down-recent-iran-strikes/)
- 2026-09-01: CENTCOM finishes a wave of strikes on IRGC air defenses, radars, maritime facilities, minelaying capability and communications sites. Reported locations include Bandar Abbas, Qeshm, Chabahar and Kenerak. A strike that evening hit a wedding in Kuhestak, Sirik County, killing 4 to 5 people. [CENTCOM](https://www.centcom.mil/MEDIA/PUBLIC-RELEASES/Article/4588389/centcom-completes-strikes-on-irgc-targets-in-iran/); [Al-Monitor](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/09/us-airstrikes-target-irans-bandar-abbas-qeshm-island); [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/2/what-do-we-know-about-the-fatal-us-bombing-of-a-wedding-in-irans-sirik)
- 2026-08-30: The US strikes two IRGC rocket launchers on Larak Island. AP called it the first publicly acknowledged US strike on Iranian positions since late July. Iran fires back at bases in Jordan. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/30/politics/us-iran-strikes-larak-island); [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/31/oil-prices-hormuz-iran-larak-island-centcom.html)

## 4. Base rates
- The pattern since the April ceasefire and the June memorandum of understanding is intermittent US strike waves with gaps between them: 7 May, about 9 June (Apache downing), about 7 July, late July, then a gap of roughly a month to August 30. [Wikipedia May 7](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/7_May_2026_United_States_strikes_on_Iran); [CNBC Jun 9](https://www.cnbc.com/amp/2026/06/09/trump-iran-helicopter-hormuz-strait.html); [Al Jazeera Jul 7](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/7/us-says-strikes-launched-as-explosions-heard-in-southern-iran)
- 14-day gaps have happened often. A Polymarket "by August 12" contract reportedly resolved Yes, and a "by July 18" contract resolved No. [polyguana](https://polyguana.com/resolved/2937527); [coingape](https://coingape.com/prediction-markets/will-us-x-iran-have-an-effective-ceasefire-by-august-31/)
- Early September is a more intense phase. The US is now targeting Iran's economy through tanker strikes on top of a blockade in place since mid-April, and analysts describe a war of attrition. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/05/us-iran-oil-tankers-navy-missile-attack.html); [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/6/us-iran-engaged-in-tanker-war-where-is-the-months-long-conflict-headed)

## 5. Other forecasts
- Undated snapshot: the September 4 contract at 27¢, September 7 at 44¢ and September 30 at 75¢. I could not confirm when this was taken. [polym.trade](https://polym.trade/event/us-x-iran-effective-ceasefire-begins-byptptpt-2-week-pause)
- Earlier related contracts: "by August 31" traded around 51 to 53% at one point and around 95% at another. Sources are inconsistent on these. [CryptoRank](https://cryptorank.io/news/feed/ac8d6-polymarket-cuts-us-iran-ceasefire-odds-as-fresh-strike-risks-rattle-crypto-markets); [Blockonomi](https://blockonomi.com/us-iran-ceasefire-odds-drop-on-polymarket-this-week)
- I found no expert forecasts or Kalshi or Manifold equivalents.

- 2026-09-15, 12:00 PM ET: the earliest a clean period could finish, assuming September 1 was the last qualifying strike. Any US air or missile strike on Iranian land or internal waters before then restarts the clock. A restart on September 5 or later would fall after the September 4 deadline.
- Ongoing triggers: Trump vowed on August 31 to hit Iran "hard." [Time](https://time.com/article/2026/08/31/us-iran-strikes-larak-island/) The IRGC has kept firing ballistic missiles at US warships, and CENTCOM said on September 8 this happened twice in two days. Iran keeps attacking US bases and shipping. Each of these could lead to new US strikes on coastal radars or launchers.
- Possible dispute over whether the tanker strikes near Kharg or Jask were inside Iranian internal waters. The rules allow up to 3 extra days when sources conflict.
- Diplomacy: Pakistani officials are reportedly mediating with Tehran (Al Jazeera live page, details unclear). Gulf states reportedly talked Washington out of resuming the war in early August. [GlobalSecurity](https://www.globalsecurity.org/military/ops/iran-war-20260906.htm)
